root_cause: The L2 is mounted too late on the balance curve and the small selected L3 branches again at its tip, producing a generic Y-fork instead of a functional side echo.
proposed_change: Move the L2 mount earlier, use the upper end of the allowed child length range for a readable side sweep, retain legal L3 candidates, and reject L3 visually for this unit because the residual lobe has no compositional capacity for another split.
